statements.text: Scott begins his second season as the head women's soccer coach at McDaniel in 2025.
Scott was promoted to head coach on March 28, 2024 after seven seasons as an assistant coach, during which he helped the team win over 70 percent of its games, posting a record of 81-29-14.
